title: 第二十五章 剧本不对第二十六章
slug: 穿进男频爽文反派师尊科学修仙
lines: 段莫弃身上有大片血迹，走进洞腔站定两三秒的功夫脚边就已经汇聚了一个小血洼。他面色平淡，甚至冷淡地向着方才【藤木之晶】所在位置看了一眼，那里如今自然已是空空如也。
解清玄可以肯定，那些血迹不是他自己的，因为他的道袍除了颜色改变，其他可以说是工工整整毫无褶皱，一丁点破损都没有。而看这出血量，那只有结丹修为的散修应当是活不成了。
段莫弃到底是如何以炼气末期的修为毫发无损地杀掉那结丹散修的呢？
或者说他现在真的还只是炼气末期吗？
解清玄害怕暴露自己的存在，不敢轻易放出神识探查段莫弃的修为。
眼前这个浑身是血的淡漠之人实在是没法让解清玄联想到那个对她彬彬有礼、十分尊敬、十二分客气的“小天使”。
就这样子，说他是反派boss解清玄都信的！
总之……不管这小子身上发生了什么，她现在最好还是以不变应万变，在这缝隙里苟住，等灵力恢复的差不多就赶紧遁走！
段莫弃见【藤木之晶】消失没有吃惊，也没有好奇地近身查看，只是面色沉静地原地盘腿坐了下来。他从百宝袋中取出块灵石结晶，吞下颗【蕴灵丹】，似是在安静恢复灵力，又好像是在等什么人。
待手中的灵石结晶暗淡枯竭，他再次缓缓抬头看向【藤木之晶】所在，波澜不惊地开口了：“前辈修为不低，何故在那缝隙之中躲躲藏藏？”
‘他是什么时候发现我的？’解清玄此前没有察觉到任何神识的探查与触碰，什么都没有！
不过……那【藤木之晶】没长腿，若是不见了，只能是被什么人偷偷取走了……兴许是段莫弃眼神好，没用神识，直接隔着那么远的距离看见了树根之后的自己？
啧……她是不是换个地方藏，也就没这出了！
“前辈，秘境入口还有几个时辰就要关闭了，您若是再不走可能便要被困在秘境之中了。”
此时的段莫弃虽然依旧面无表情，但他言语中还算客气，不像是一言不合就要像对付那散修一样直接开始死斗。
对嘛，反正那【藤木之晶】如今已经被她融了，分是分不出去了，段莫弃也不能因为这已经没了的东西跟师尊撕破脸皮，动起手来吧？
以这孩子的性子，应当是要在心里记下她这一笔的，但来日方长，这掉下去的好感度她可以以后再刷回来嘛！
此时解清玄的灵力恢复了约有三分之一，足够用出几次遁术，差不多该往秘境传送门那边赶了。
如此想着，解清玄身子一动刚要出去，却突然察觉到空间上的一丝违和感。
这狭小的缝隙怎么好像……变大了不少？
‘如果不是这洞穴在挤压，那就只能是……’
她的身形变小了啊喂！
顿时，解清玄的后脊梁又渗出汗来……
话说……她胸前是什么时候出现了这熟悉又陌生的垂坠感的？
她挤着眼睛，撇着嘴，双手又往下探去。
‘嗯。’她那才熟悉不久的幻肢又消失了。
‘不是！这是合意啊！’她怎么能又变回女身的啊？她什么时候又变回女身的啊？什么原理啊这是？
不管是什么原因，这变身是不是稍微有点不是时候啊！
等等……
这变身好像……正是时候？
content_en:
There was a large amount of blood on Duan Moqi's body. When he walked into the cave and stood there for two or three seconds, a small puddle of blood had already gathered at his feet. His expression was dull, and he even glanced indifferently at the location of the [Wine and Wood Crystal] just now, which was naturally empty now.
Xie Qingxuan was certain that those bloodstains were not his own, because apart from the change in color, his Taoist robe was completely wrinkle-free and not damaged at all. And looking at the amount of blood loss, the casual cultivator who only had the cultivation of pill formation should not be able to survive.
How on earth did Duan Moqi kill the pill-forming casual cultivator without any damage at his late stage of Qi refining?
Or is he really still in the final stage of Qi refining?
Jie Qingxuan was afraid of exposing his existence and did not dare to easily release his spiritual consciousness to explore Duan Mo Qi's cultivation.
The indifferent person covered in blood in front of her really couldn't make Xie Qingxuan think of the "little angel" who was polite, respectful and polite to her.
Just like this, everyone believes that he is the villain boss Jie Qingxuan!
In short... no matter what happens to this kid, it's best for her to remain unchanged in the face of all changes, stay in this gap, and escape as soon as her spiritual power is almost restored!
Duan Moqi was not surprised when he saw the [Wine Crystal] disappeared, nor did he take a closer look curiously. He just sat down cross-legged with a calm expression. He took out a piece of spiritual stone crystal from the treasure bag and swallowed a [Spirit Accumulating Pill], as if he was quietly recovering his spiritual power, and also seemed to be waiting for someone.
When the spirit stone crystal in his hand turned dim and exhausted, he slowly raised his head again to look at the [Wine Crystal] and spoke calmly: "Senior, your cultivation level is not low, why are you hiding in that gap?"
'When did he discover me? ’ Jie Qingxuan had not noticed any exploration or touch of divine consciousness before, nothing!
But... that [Wine Crystal] has no legs. If it is missing, it can only be taken away secretly by someone... Maybe Duan Moqi has good eyesight and saw himself behind the tree roots from such a long distance without using his consciousness?
Tsk... If she had found another place to hide, she wouldn't have gotten out of here!
"Senior, the entrance to the secret realm will be closed in a few hours. If you don't leave, you may be trapped in the secret realm."
Although Duan Moqi was still expressionless at this time, his words were still polite, and it was not like he would start a fight to the death just like he did with the loose cultivator if they disagreed with each other.
Well, anyway, the [Wine and Wood Crystal] has been melted by her now and cannot be separated. Duan Moqi can't quarrel with his master because of this gone thing, right?
With this child's temperament, she should keep this record in mind, but the time is long, and she can regain the favorability she has dropped in the future!
At this time, Jie Qingxuan's spiritual power had recovered by about one-third, which was enough to use several escape techniques. It was almost time to rush to the secret realm portal.
Thinking like this, Xie Qingxuan moved his body and was about to go out, but suddenly noticed a sense of dissonance in the space.
Why does this small gap seem to... get a lot bigger?
'If this cave isn't squeezing, it can only be...'
Her figure has become smaller!
Suddenly, sweat broke out on Xie Qingxuan's back again...
By the way...when did this familiar yet unfamiliar drapey feeling appear on her chest?
She squeezed her eyes, curled her lips, and reached down again with her hands.
'Um. ’ Her phantom limb, which she had just become familiar with, disappeared again.
'no! This is desirable! ’ How could she transform back into a female body? When did she change back to a woman? What is the principle of this?
No matter what the reason is, this transformation is just a little bit wrong!
Wait...
This transformation seems... just the right time?
